content.summary: Digital engineering services company EPAM Systems (NYSE:EPAM) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 19.4% year on year to $1.39 billion. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $1.39 billion at the midpoint, 0.8% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.08 per share was 1.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
